iterations.summary: Baseline is the comparability anchor for every `patch_landing` review this run. Please emit it with (a) an explicit `baseline_label`, (b) the full workload tuple `conc=4 / isl=1024 / osl=1024 / max_model_len=6144 / bf16 / tp=1`, and (c) an accuracy-gate reading taken on the same server instance. Without the accuracy reading captured here, later promotion proposals will have no floor to compare against and will land on `needs_review` rather than `approve`.

Make the breakdown attribute the PRELUDE overrun to a named cause (model fetch / server boot / warmup) rather than a bare duration — a 74% PRELUDE share with zero optimisation phases is the single reusable lesson from this run, and it is only actionable if the sub-cost is identified. Also flag `framework_agent`/`kernel` disabled and the skipped sweep as *configuration* outcomes, not failures, so a future run does not mine this session as evidence that those paths regress.
